description: logserver file outputs at boot config: PV_LOG_LEVEL=2 filtering, filetree+singlefile, golang/strftime timestamps, absolute tsec, dmesg and loggers on

config.env: PV_CONTROL_REMOTE=0 PV_LOG_LEVEL=2 PV_LOG_SERVER_OUTPUTS=filetree,singlefile PV_LOG_FILETREE_TIMESTAMP_FORMAT=golang:RFC822Z PV_LOG_SINGLEFILE_TIMESTAMP_FORMAT=strftime:%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S PV_LOG_TIMESTAMP=absolute PV_LOG_CAPTURE_DMESG=1 PV_LOG_LOGGERS=1
